archetype: ARCHETYPE 4: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST + ARCHETYPE 1: ORGANIC & EARTHY (Clean Light Minimal)
emotional_tone: Swiss precision, financial clarity, trustworthy, effortless tactile utility

identity_and_vision.concept: FinControl is an executive personal investment & finance engine. It blends Swiss architectural precision with soft tactile neutrals, delivering maximum scannability and instant financial clarity across desktop and iPhone PWA views.
core_principles: Tactical Minimalism: Crisp 1px subtle borders, zero unnecessary card shadows, high scannability.
Dual-Currency Harmony: Clear distinction between Trading Bot USD operations and EUR Funds/Expenses, backed by real-time converted EUR consolidated totals.
Mobile-First PWA Precision: Native mobile bottom tab navigation with haptic micro-interactions, turning desktop power into pocket agility.
Restrained Color Intent: 95% monochrome neutral backbone; emerald green reserved strictly for positive gain, rose for spend/loss, and subtle indigo for bot metrics.

layout_and_spacing.desktop_navigation: Fixed left sidebar (width: 260px) with logo, user profile badge, navigation links with active pill states, currency rate preview, and logout button.
layout_and_spacing.mobile_navigation: Fixed bottom tab bar with 5 key tab triggers (Dashboard, Trading Bot, Funds, Expenses, Settings) featuring smooth icon highlights and active underline indicator.

pwa_and_mobile_specifications.manifest: PWA webmanifest configured with theme_color #FAFAFA, background_color #FFFFFF, display standalone, short_name FinControl.
pwa_and_mobile_specifications.safe_areas: Use env(safe-area-inset-bottom) padding on mobile bottom navigation to protect iPhone home indicator.
pwa_and_mobile_specifications.touch_targets: Minimum 44px height for interactive buttons, table actions, and form controls on touch screens.

component_guidelines.cards: Cardless or subtle 1px border cards (`border border-zinc-200 bg-white rounded-xl`). Avoid heavy drop shadows; rely on crisp internal padding (`p-5` or `p-6`) and alignment.
component_guidelines.buttons: Pill-shaped or rounded-lg with sharp interaction feedback. Primary: `bg-zinc-900 text-white hover:bg-zinc-800 active:scale-[0.98] transition-all`. Secondary: `border border-zinc-200 bg-white text-zinc-900 hover:bg-zinc-50`.
component_guidelines.tables: Clean, dense data tables with subtle row dividers (`border-b border-zinc-100`), inline action buttons (edit/delete), and badge tags for USD/EUR currencies.
component_guidelines.inputs_and_forms: Use Shadcn Input/Select with high visibility focus rings (`focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-zinc-900 focus-visible:ring-offset-1`). Include currency prefix icons ($ or €) on monetary inputs.
component_guidelines.disclaimer_banner: Noticeable yet elegant informational card with soft amber outline (`bg-amber-50/60 border border-amber-200/80 text-amber-900 rounded-lg p-4 text-xs`). Must state: 'Estimates & projections are for informational purposes only and do not constitute financial advice.'

auth_screens.design: Centered minimal card on soft background with dual toggle (Sign In / Create Account), email/password inputs, validation errors using Sonner toasts, and immediate demo credentials shortcut for rapid evaluator testing.

Total Monthly Expenses KPI (EUR with 5-category quick gauge)

motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Framer Motion layout animations with `initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 6 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.2 }} `.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Subtle translate lift (`-translate-y-0.5`) and background tint on interactive rows and cards.
motion_and_interactions.toast_notifications: Sonner toasts for record creation, editing, deletion, and exchange rate updates.

accessibility_and_contrast.data_testid: MANDATORY on all key interactive elements (e.g., `data-testid="bot-return-submit-button"`, `data-testid="expense-category-select"`, `data-testid="consolidated-eur-total"`).
accessibility_and_contrast.contrast_ratio: APCA AA standard; black text (#09090B) on crisp white (#FFFFFF) background provides high visibility.
accessibility_and_contrast.focus_states: High contrast ring indicators for keyboard users.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the exact 5 expense categories strictly: Food, Transport, Leisure, Housing, Other.
Always perform monetary consolidation in EUR while respecting native Trading Bot entries in USD.
Ensure all monetary numbers formatting uses standard localized currency strings (e.g. €1,245.50 / $850.00).
Add clear disclaimers on both Dashboard and Trading Bot sections stating that projections are estimates and not financial advice.
Implement persistent storage with full CRUD capabilities (Add, Edit, Delete) for daily returns, fund records, fund contributions, expenses, and exchange rates.
Support desktop sidebar + mobile bottom tab navigation bar, making it fully installable and responsive as a PWA.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Exclude transforms from universal transitions.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Maintain left-aligned natural typography flow.
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or rounded-lg with interaction animations).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (e.g., 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯) for icons; use lucide-react icons instead.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute for robust testing.
